supersession_reason: Technical ordering repair before any authoritative realm or GBIF result: the balanced source/target split must be applied after response-blind SDM occurrence admissibility, otherwise deterministic occurrence failures could create an avoidably imbalanced dyadic geometry.

stage_A_biological_eligibility.realm_source: WWF (2004) Simplified Biogeographical Realms of the World / UNEP-WCMC FeatureServer
stage_A_biological_eligibility.realm_assignment_uses: exact response-blind frozen genetic-panel localities only

stage_B_sdm_occurrence_admissibility.failed_species: remove deterministically before role split; do not backfill

stage_C_role_split.rule: Sort Stage-B survivors by SHA256(namespace+'|'+species); lower half = source, upper half = target.

stage_D_sdm_fit.rule: Fit the prespecified SDM for every Stage-C species. Cross-validation metrics are diagnostics and cannot be used to drop individual species post-split.
stage_D_sdm_fit.numerical_failure: If any required species cannot produce a finite model/surface under the fixed method, stop the whole program as NOT_EVALUABLE_SDM_FIT rather than pruning or backfilling.
